title: Keep the source owner visible

nodes.label: Domain and policy owners
nodes.detail: Maintain authoritative rules, interfaces and acceptance conditions.

nodes.label: Workflow maintainer
nodes.detail: Assemble the task packet with source versions or retrieval times.

nodes.label: Product team and reviewer
nodes.detail: Use the packet to perform and judge the work; return conflicts to the source owner.

textEquivalent: Domain and policy owners maintain authoritative rules, interfaces and acceptance conditions. The workflow maintainer assembles a task packet with source versions or retrieval times. The product team and reviewer use that packet, and unresolved conflicts go back to the responsible source owner.
